description.value: Scrubbing fallout dust out of a wound before it cooks the flesh underneath is a skill in itself out here. You can attempt a Medicine check to reduce the stage of a creature's radiation sickness by one, once per day per patient, as if Treating Disease.

cinderfall.incomplete: Reducing a custom radiation-sickness stage by one via Medicine, once per day per patient, has no rule-element representation -- radiation sickness's stage progression is Cinderfall's own bespoke counter with no actor-schema hook.
